why: The long version of the Momentum review for YouTube: the review joined to the after, the prospect talk and the dead weight out (the same cuts as the owner's version), the level set for YouTube, captions as a .srt beside it. Jonathan, 2026-10-05: "export those videos as long form for YouTube."

cuts: the opener for a general audience and the line that calls them a prospect
a guess about them, not a fact: the copy being written by ChatGPT
a repeat: reviews closer to the call to action was said 30 seconds earlier
the close trails off and promises work 'automatically'
undersells the work: it did not take much time to put together
a repeat of the line before it: what the buyer gets from the offering
not accurate: the render's form sends nothing to his inbox
not accurate and muddled: the 'neighbors' band was not made smaller
false starts and a line about enjoying the work
trails off after the ask to use the page as a reference
